verdict.rationale: Digits documents an AI-native month-end close that starts reconciliation before month-end, runs quality control, and surfaces exceptions with context. It also describes real-time reconciliation and transaction flagging with smart reviews, so the core of the story is the product's own capability. However, all evidence is vendor marketing: transaction matching mechanics and the human-review handoff for the prepared close are only implied, not documented in depth, and the external MCP agent surface is read-only, so the user's own agent cannot drive the close. Missing for 10: documented transaction-matching mechanics, an explicit human-review/sign-off step for the prepared close, write-capable agent access for external agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: an AI-native month-end close workflow that collects financial activity continuously, books transactions inside the ledger, starts reconciliation before month-end, generates schedules, runs quality control, surfaces exceptions, and produces reports from the live ledger
Surfaces exceptions with context on what was attempted and why
Real-time reconciliation, categorization, and classification of inbound transactions and financial data
Digits AI learns your business to provide 24/7 bookkeeping with transaction flagging & smart reviews
collaboration features that let business owners, finance teams, and accountants review and share financials without exporting into spreadsheets
